findings.note: The left side is the sum from the previous line, (10 − T/2) + (10 − T/3) = 20 − 5T/6, not 40 − 5T/6. The line as printed is false and does not give the stated result: 40 − 5T/6 = −20 + 4T solves to T = 360/29 = 12.4 N, not 240/29. Only the correct 20 − 5T/6 = −20 + 4T gives 40 = 29T/6 and T = 240/29.
